paragraphs.text: Keeping bees in cities has become popular in recent years, and some rooftops now hold several hives. Urban bees often produce more honey than bees in the countryside, because city parks and gardens offer a wide variety of flowers over a long season. However, beekeepers warn that too many hives in one area can leave bees without enough food, and several cities now ask new beekeepers to register their hives.
